summary: Verified the Vercel build regression fix and full app regression. `cd /app/frontend && rm -rf .next && yarn build` exits 0 and emits the expected routes table: / (static), /_not-found (static), /company/[slug] (SSG) with all 3 slugs (kailash-lawyers, koala-invest, kuber-projects) = 7 static pages. The previous PageNotFoundError for /_not-found is gone. Backend: 13/14 pytest tests pass (health, status CRUD+persistence, enquiries create/list/validation, frontend route reachability). Frontend: all 8 home sections render, direct + client-side company routing works, custom 404 returns real HTTP 404 with 'Back to Kailash Group' link, and the contact form POSTs /api/enquiries -> 200 with the sonner 'Thank you' toast and form reset. Note: the initial run showed / and company routes returning 500 purely because `rm -rf .next` was executed against the live dev server; after `supervisorctl restart frontend` all routes returned 200. This is a local-dev artifact only, NOT a product bug (Vercel builds in a clean workspace).

minor.issue: Soft 404: an unknown company slug (e.g. /company/not-a-company) returns HTTP 200 and renders CompanyView's client-side 'Company not found' fallback instead of a real 404. Bad for SEO/crawlers. Fix: in src/app/company/[slug]/page.jsx call notFound() from 'next/navigation' when COMPANIES.find(...) is undefined (and/or set `export const dynamicParams = false`).
Always returns 200 even when both Resend emails fail (exceptions only logged). Caller cannot distinguish 'stored + emailed' from 'stored, email dropped'. Consider returning an email_status flag.

ui_bugs.issue: The orbit company buttons are perpetually animated (bbox moved ~9px x / ~11px y in 600ms), so Playwright's normal click times out with 'element is not stable' and real users have to chase a moving target. Force-click confirms routing works. Recommend pausing the orbit animation on hover/focus (animation-play-state: paused) so the click target settles.

Tailwind emits a build warning on every build: 'The class `duration-[1200ms]` is ambiguous and matches multiple utilities' (collides with tailwindcss-animate's animation-duration). Build still succeeds but the utility may not apply as intended. Fix: use `[transition-duration:1200ms]`.

issues: 'Area of interest' uses a native browser <select> (data-testid='contact-company') styled with the text-input class, so it renders the OS default dropdown arrow/menu and visually mismatches the rest of the glass form. Replace with the shadcn Select component for consistency.

action_items: Call notFound() in src/app/company/[slug]/page.jsx for unknown slugs so /company/<bad-slug> returns HTTP 404 instead of a soft 200.
Replace `duration-[1200ms]` with `[transition-duration:1200ms]` in src/sections/Community.jsx:28 and src/sections/Services.jsx:42 to clear the Tailwind ambiguous-class build warning.
Pause the ecosystem orbit animation on hover/focus so the company cards are a stable click target.
Optional: swap the native <select> in Contact.jsx for the shadcn Select to match the design system.
critical_code_review_comments: src/app/company/[slug]/page.jsx renders CompanyView for any slug; the 'not found' state is handled client-side, defeating the new not-found.jsx work for the /company subtree.
next.config.js hardcodes the preview hostname in allowedDevOrigins — harmless on Vercel (dev-only) but should ideally be env-driven.

package.json still carries CRA-era deps (react-scripts, cra-template, @craco/craco, react-router-dom) after the Next migration; removing them shrinks the Vercel install/build time and removes a source of resolution conflicts.

server.py reads EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY/EMAIL_FROM_NAME/OWNER_EMAIL via os.environ[...] at import time — correct fail-fast, but these must be set in the deployment environment or the backend will refuse to boot.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of core flows (orbit click needs force due to animation)

seed_data_creation: Created 3 test enquiries (name prefixed TEST_QA_/TEST_MIN_, email delivered@resend.dev) and TEST_ status_check docs via the public API. Contact-form UI test also created one enquiry for 'QA Test Bot'.
test_credentials: None required (no auth in app); /app/memory/test_credentials.md not needed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env). It covers /api/, /api/status, /api/enquiries and frontend route reachability. The one known failure is TestFrontendRoutes::test_unknown_company_slug_404 (soft-404 defect, intentionally left strict). IMPORTANT: do NOT run `rm -rf .next` while the supervisor dev server is running — it makes every route 500 until `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`. Orbit ecosystem buttons need click(force=True) because of the continuous animation.
rca_of_the_issue: Original Vercel failure (PageNotFoundError / 'Failed to collect page data for /_not-found') was caused by the App Router having no explicit not-found boundary after the CRA->Next migration; adding src/app/not-found.jsx supplies the module Next tries to collect during the prerender phase. The Tailwind `duration-[1.2s]` -> `duration-[1200ms]` change removed the hard error but a residual ambiguity warning remains. Verified fix by running the exact Vercel command (`next build`) on a cleaned .next: exit 0, 7/7 pages generated. Both fixes are non-regressive — home, SSG company pages, client-side routing, the 404 route (real HTTP 404) and the contact form -> POST /api/enquiries (200) all still work end-to-end.
